about_short_description.short_description: Ebana is an equity management platform.

product.name: Equity Management and Cap Table
product.description: A digital platform to manage company ownership structures and equity transactions, including cap table and shareholder registry management.

product.name: Assemblies and Resolutions
product.description: A fully digital solution to conduct corporate assemblies and resolutions, including meeting invitations, online voting, and document management.

product.name: Employee Stock Program
product.description: A digital platform to create and manage flexible employee share programs with contract creation, legal support, and performance-based vesting.

product.name: Investor Relations
product.description: A secure communication portal for sharing sensitive investor documents and managing investor relations with a designated relationship officer.

product.name: Investment Operations Support
product.description: A service to connect companies with qualified investors and support seamless investment transactions with legal assistance.

product.name: Share Buybacks
product.description: An automated, legally supported service to manage the process of buying back company shares and allocating treasury shares.
